reviews.text: Excellent school! Master Roper and Miss Hilda work with all the students to help them be the best they can be.
Not only are the instructors excellent, but the staff makes you feel like you are family. This form of Martial Arts is sophisticated, challenging and habit forming. Definitely worth joining.
My family has been taking Kuk Sool for 4 years now and truly is an amazing martial art and even better studio! Suh Suhk Roper and Mrs. Hilda are the best too!
